_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Beyond#000.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief {u} on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#000.dst: Şey... öyle, ama önce {u} adlı kahramana ayrıntıları anlatmak istiyorum. Bu tehlikeli bir görev, o yüzden... bilgilendirmek en iyisi.
A Journey Beyond#000.speaker: Elphaba

similar.text: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.

A Journey Beyond#001.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Beyond#002.src: ...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
A Journey Beyond#002.dst: ...Hm? Ah- ıı, merhaba. Kusura bakma, burası şey için ayrıldı...
A Journey Beyond#002.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#003.src: Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
A Journey Beyond#003.dst: Dur. Tam aradığımız kişi sen olabilirsin. Savaşta becerikli birine benziyorsun. Tehlikeli, çok gizli bir göreve katılmaya ne dersin?
A Journey Beyond#003.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#004.src: ...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#004.dst: ...Bunu daha iyi ifade edebilirdim. Bak, mesele şu- dördüncü birine ihtiyacımız var. Sana durumu anlatayım, katılmak istemezsen... başka birini buluruz. Ne dersin? Tamam, hadi, beni takip et.
A Journey Beyond#004.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#005.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#005.dst: Bu da kim? Gerçekten dördüncü birini mi buldun? Hadi ama, ihtiyacımız yok demiştim!
A Journey Beyond#005.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#007.src: ... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
A Journey Beyond#007.dst: ... {u}, sen misin? Vay, epey oldu. Kusura bakma, şu an sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Tehlikeli bir göreve hazırlanıyoruz ve...
A Journey Beyond#007.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#008.src: Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
A Journey Beyond#008.dst: Şey. Aslında aramıza katılacak dördüncü birini arıyorduk. Ve... sen o pozisyona uygun görünüyorsun. Tabii- tabii katılmak istersen.
A Journey Beyond#008.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#009.src: Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#009.dst: Bak ne diyeceğim. Sana durumu anlatayım, katılmak istemezsen... başka birini buluruz. Ne dersin? Tamam, hadi, beni takip et.
A Journey Beyond#009.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#011.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
A Journey Beyond#011.dst: Biz de ikimiz sana neden yanıldığını söyleyip duruyoruz. Bu {u}, daha önce birlikte çalıştık.
A Journey Beyond#011.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#012.src: Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head
A Journey Beyond#012.dst: Neyse, yola çıkmadan önce ona durumu anlatmak istiyorum
A Journey Beyond#012.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#013.src: Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should
A Journey Beyond#013.dst: Elphie, döndüm! Sonunda Aegis'i yakaladım ama pek... memnun değil. Ona göre bizim
A Journey Beyond#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#014.src: Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
A Journey Beyond#014.dst: Ah. {u}? Burada ne işin var? Tanrılar aşkına, epey oldu, değil mi?
A Journey Beyond#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#015.src: They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
A Journey Beyond#015.dst: Dördüncümüz o. Amiral hakkında ne diyordun?
A Journey Beyond#015.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#017.src: Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
A Journey Beyond#017.dst: Hiç. Dördüncümüz de varsa yola çıkmaya hazırız, değil mi?
A Journey Beyond#017.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#019.src: So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
A Journey Beyond#019.dst: Evet! {p} bölgesini biliyorsun, değil mi? Yüzlerce yıl önce topraktan zümrüt çıkarmak için madencilik yapılıyordu. Ta ki bilinmeyen bir sebeple durdurulana kadar.
A Journey Beyond#019.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#020.src: We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
A Journey Beyond#020.dst: Her şeyi bilmiyoruz ama... kanıtlar, Wynn eyaletinin keşfedilmemiş bir bölümüne ulaştıklarını gösteriyor. Orada... bir şey buldular.
A Journey Beyond#020.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#021.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted- they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#021.dst: Toprağın kendisinin lanetli olduğu söyleniyordu. Yozlaşmış değil- bu konuda çok netlerdi.
A Journey Beyond#021.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#022.src: Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#022.dst: O yerde başka bir güç yuva kurmuş. Bulabildiğimiz birkaç rapor oradan sadece Silent Expanse diye bahsediyor.
A Journey Beyond#022.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#023.src: The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
A Journey Beyond#023.dst: Bu yeni tehdidin yayılmasını önlemek için madenler mühürlendi ama çatlaklar görünmeye başladı.
A Journey Beyond#023.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#024.src: Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
A Journey Beyond#024.dst: Tuhaf, bu dünyaya ait olmayan yaratıklar geçmenin yolunu bulup eyaletimizi tehdit etmeye başladı.
A Journey Beyond#024.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#025.src: The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
A Journey Beyond#025.dst: Bu yerin varlığı sadece bilmesi gerekenlere açıklandı.
A Journey Beyond#025.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#026.src: That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
A Journey Beyond#026.dst: İşte burada biz devreye giriyoruz! Madenlerde savaşarak ilerleyip olası tehlikenin boyutunu keşfedeceğiz.
A Journey Beyond#026.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#027.src: And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
A Journey Beyond#027.dst: Böyle oturup durursak da yapamayacağız! Acemiye anlattınız, hadi artık gidelim!
A Journey Beyond#027.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#028.src: H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
A Journey Beyond#028.dst: H-hey! Benim güzel mekânıma ne yapıyorsunuz!
A Journey Beyond#028.speaker: Rusty Bartender

A Journey Beyond#029.src: ...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
A Journey Beyond#029.dst: ...Hay aksi. Hâlâ burada olduğunu unuttum. Kusura bakma, meyhaneci! Tamir ederim!
A Journey Beyond#029.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#030.src: Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
A Journey Beyond#030.dst: Lucio, böyle devam edemezsin... ah, boş ver. Ben malzemeleri toplarım... Aledar, bizi madenlere götürebilir misin?
A Journey Beyond#030.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#031.src: Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
A Journey Beyond#031.dst: Emredersiniz hanımefendi! {u}, hazır olduğunda yola çıkalım.
A Journey Beyond#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#032.src: Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
A Journey Beyond#032.dst: Ekibini Silent Expanse'in girişine doğru takip et.

A Journey Beyond#033.dst: Herkes hazır mı? Ben önden gideceğim.
A Journey Beyond#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#034.src: It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
A Journey Beyond#034.dst: Yollarımızın burada kesişmesi kaderin cilvesi, {u}. Yolculuğumuza birlikte başladık ve şimdi...
A Journey Beyond#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#037.src: Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
A Journey Beyond#037.dst: Ah, sorun değil. Bunları ben hallederim.
A Journey Beyond#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#039.src: This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
A Journey Beyond#039.dst: Aslında bu ikinci denememiz. İlkinde işler pek iyi gitmedi.
A Journey Beyond#039.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#040.src: We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
A Journey Beyond#040.dst: Artık sayımız daha fazla, Lucio ve sen onu alt etmemize yardım edersiniz.
A Journey Beyond#040.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#041.src: Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
A Journey Beyond#041.dst: O kadar güçlü olamaz, bahse girerim tek başıma hallederim.
A Journey Beyond#041.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#042.src: We managed to seal it in but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
A Journey Beyond#042.dst: Onu içeri hapsetmeyi başardık ama {~} kişi olunca eminim ki-
A Journey Beyond#042.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#046.src: What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
A Journey Beyond#046.dst: Ne var bunda bu kadar? Hallederiz diyen sendin!
A Journey Beyond#046.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#056.src: Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
A Journey Beyond#056.dst: Bana mı öyle geliyor, yoksa saldırılarımız HİÇBİR ŞEY yapmıyor mu?
A Journey Beyond#056.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#057.src: Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
A Journey Beyond#057.dst: Lucio haklı! Plan değişti. Lucio, onu yerinde tutmama yardım et.
A Journey Beyond#057.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#058.src: Aledar, you know what to do.
A Journey Beyond#058.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#059.src: {u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
A Journey Beyond#059.dst: {u}, benimle gel! Mağaranın girişini kapatmak için bir büyü yap ki canavar çıkamasın.
A Journey Beyond#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#060.src: I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
A Journey Beyond#060.dst: Ben saldırmasını engellerim, sen de girişi bir büyüyle kapat.
A Journey Beyond#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#061.src: They won't be able to hold it for long.
A Journey Beyond#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#062.dst: Hazır mısın?! Herhangi bir büyü yap!
A Journey Beyond#062.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#064.src: Plan a way of killing the beast.

A Journey Beyond#066.dst: Arkadaşlar... Yardım eden yok mu? Sıkıştım!
A Journey Beyond#066.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#067.src: Phew, here. Let me get you out.
A Journey Beyond#067.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#068.src: I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
A Journey Beyond#068.dst: Özür dilerim ekip. Daha önce böyle bir canavar görmemiştim.
A Journey Beyond#068.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#069.src: It looks like our problem isn't firepower. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#069.dst: Sorunumuz ateş gücü değil gibi. Başka bir şey. Silahlarımız onu hiç etkilemedi sanki.
A Journey Beyond#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#070.src: I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
A Journey Beyond#070.dst: Bize yardım edebilecek birini tanıyorum. {p} üzerinde bir demirci.
A Journey Beyond#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#071.src: {u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
A Journey Beyond#071.dst: {u}, evin koordinatlarını kitabına yazdım. Orada buluşalım.
A Journey Beyond#071.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#073.src: Just in time. We're all here.
A Journey Beyond#073.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#074.src: It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
A Journey Beyond#074.dst: Görünüşe göre Demirci sorunun ne olduğunu biliyor...
A Journey Beyond#074.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#075.src: So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
A Journey Beyond#075.dst: Evet, Dren. Canavara neden hasar veremediğimizi biliyor musun?
A Journey Beyond#075.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#076.src: Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
A Journey Beyond#076.dst: Elbette! Sorununuz elementlerle ilgili. Bildiğiniz gibi {~} element var...
A Journey Beyond#076.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#082.src: But.. There is a hidden element, Darkness .
A Journey Beyond#082.dst: Ama.. Gizli bir element daha var, Karanlık .
A Journey Beyond#082.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#083.src: Thank grook for that. I was wondering if we'd ever be rid of this nightmare.
A Journey Beyond#083.dst: Grook'a şükür. Bu kâbustan hiç kurtulacak mıyız diye merak ediyordum.

A Journey Beyond#084.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry, I didn't catch your name. {u}? {u}.
A Journey Beyond#084.dst: Biz de ikimiz sana neden yanıldığını söyleyip duruyoruz. Bu... kusura bakma, adını duymadım. {u} mu? {u}.
A Journey Beyond#084.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#085.src: In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
A Journey Beyond#085.dst: Karanlık bir yaratığa hasar vermek için o etkiyi ruhunuzdan atmanız gerekir.
A Journey Beyond#085.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#086.src: Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
A Journey Beyond#086.dst: Bazı Karanlık yaratıklar, Karanlık etkisindeki başka yaratıkların onlara zarar vermesini engelleyen bir tür eşzamanlı bariyer kullanır.
A Journey Beyond#086.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#087.src: In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
A Journey Beyond#087.dst: Sizi arındırmak için {~} güçlü eşyaya ihtiyacım olacak.
A Journey Beyond#087.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#088.src: Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
A Journey Beyond#088.dst: İlk olarak, bir Dernic Beast'ten bir parça. {p} bölgesinin derinliklerinde bir tane yaşıyor.
A Journey Beyond#088.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#089.src: I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
A Journey Beyond#089.dst: Bunu hepinizdeki karanlık elementi açığa çıkarmak için kullanacağım.
A Journey Beyond#089.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#090.src: And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
A Journey Beyond#090.dst: Sonra da elbette hepinizi arındırmak için bir Işık eşyası...
A Journey Beyond#090.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#091.src: Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
A Journey Beyond#091.dst: Dur... Işık eşyası derken neyi kastediyorsun?
A Journey Beyond#091.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#092.src: Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel fairies if you wanted.
A Journey Beyond#092.dst: Herhangi bir Işık yaratığından bir şey işe yarar, istersen Gavel perilerinden biraz toz alabilirsin.
A Journey Beyond#092.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#094.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the Darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#094.dst: Tamam. Aledar, sen {u} ile Karanlık eşyasını al, ben de Lucio ile Işık eşyasını alırım.
A Journey Beyond#094.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#097.src: Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#097.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#098.src: We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
A Journey Beyond#098.dst: Köklerin etrafındaki mağaraların sandığımızdan çok daha karmaşık olduğunu gördük...
A Journey Beyond#098.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#099.src: There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
A Journey Beyond#099.dst: Çok daha güçlü yaratıkların olduğu bir tane var... Bir yerde... İşte!
A Journey Beyond#099.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#100.src: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
A Journey Beyond#100.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#101.src: I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
A Journey Beyond#101.dst: Büyüyle karşıya geçebileceğimizi sanmıyorum, {u}! Bize... Kanat gibi bir şey lazım!
A Journey Beyond#101.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#102.src: I've never used wings like this before...
A Journey Beyond#102.dst: Daha önce hiç böyle kanat kullanmadım...
A Journey Beyond#102.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#103.src: I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
A Journey Beyond#103.dst: Bence onları tutup normal yürürsek karşıya süzülmemize yardım eder.
A Journey Beyond#103.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#104.src: Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
A Journey Beyond#104.dst: Düşürme ve lav fışkırmalarına yakalanma, belli ki.
A Journey Beyond#104.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#105.src: Don't forget why we are here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
A Journey Beyond#105.dst: Neden burada olduğumuzu unutma, karanlık bir yaratık arıyoruz. Bulursan bana seslen.
A Journey Beyond#105.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#106.src: Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.
A Journey Beyond#106.dst: Parça için [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki mağaranın derinlerine in.

A Journey Beyond#107.src: That's our target! Go after it!
A Journey Beyond#107.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#108.src: Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!
A Journey Beyond#108.dst: Dur, neden burada bizimle savaşmıyor? Dikkat! Tuzak olabilir!
A Journey Beyond#108.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#109.src: Chase the beast for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#110.src: Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.

A Journey Beyond#111.src: Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
A Journey Beyond#111.dst: [{~} Corrupted Pearl] için Mangled Progeny'yi öldür.

A Journey Beyond#112.src: Wow, I'm impressed . I honestly thought you would need my help.
A Journey Beyond#112.dst: Vay, etkilendim . Açıkçası yardımıma ihtiyacın olur sanıyordum.
A Journey Beyond#112.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#113.src: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
A Journey Beyond#113.dst: Neyse, almaya geldiğimizi aldık. Dren'e dönelim.
A Journey Beyond#113.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#114.src: Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item.

A Journey Beyond#115.src: Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
A Journey Beyond#115.dst: Bu sefer şansımız yaver gitti galiba. Karanlık eşyası buldunuz mu?
A Journey Beyond#115.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#116.src: That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here !
A Journey Beyond#116.dst: Bu iş görür. Bakalım işe yarayacak mı. Gel buraya !
A Journey Beyond#116.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#117.src: It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
A Journey Beyond#117.dst: Bitti! Karanlık etkiden kurtulmuş olmalısınız. Sizi uğraştıran o bariyeri artık aşabilirsiniz.
A Journey Beyond#117.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#118.src: Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
A Journey Beyond#118.dst: Emin misin? Pek farklı hissetmiyorum. Neyse... Öğrenmenin tek bir yolu var.
A Journey Beyond#118.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#119.src: Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
A Journey Beyond#119.dst: Kapalı girişi diğer savaşçılarla yeniden aç.

A Journey Beyond#120.src: Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
A Journey Beyond#120.dst: Herkes burada mı? Harika! Başladığım işi bitirme zamanı!
A Journey Beyond#120.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#121.src: Lucio! No! When will you learn?
A Journey Beyond#121.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#122.src: Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
A Journey Beyond#122.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#123.src: We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
A Journey Beyond#123.dst: O şeyin kaçmasını istemiyoruz, büyük bir paniğe yol açabilir.
A Journey Beyond#123.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#124.src: We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
A Journey Beyond#124.dst: Girmek için küçük bir giriş açacağız ve içeride onunla savaşacağız.
A Journey Beyond#124.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#129.src: We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
A Journey Beyond#129.dst: Elimizde madenlerin çok eski bir haritası var ama bizi neyin beklediğine dair hiçbir fikrimiz yok.
A Journey Beyond#129.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#130.src: I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
A Journey Beyond#130.dst: Sizi uyarmak istiyorum, bu hepimiz için dönüşü olmayan bir yol olabilir.
A Journey Beyond#130.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#132.src: Rocks are one thing, Lucio. The creatures we're about to face require more than brute strength. You need force of mind.
A Journey Beyond#132.dst: Kayalar başka, Lucio. Karşılaşacağımız yaratıklar kaba kuvvetten fazlasını gerektiriyor. Zihin gücü lazım.
A Journey Beyond#132.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#133.src: Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
A Journey Beyond#133.dst: Eyvah. Belki de bu pek iyi bir fikir değildir.
A Journey Beyond#133.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#134.src: It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
A Journey Beyond#134.dst: Artık çok geç. Bu görevi bitirmek zorundayız.
A Journey Beyond#134.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#136.src: Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
A Journey Beyond#136.dst: Hedefi unutma Elphie, bu diyarın sonuna ulaşmalıyız.
A Journey Beyond#136.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#137.src: It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
A Journey Beyond#137.dst: Burası hâlâ boş. Ama sanki daha dün buradaymışlar gibi görünüyor.
A Journey Beyond#137.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#138.src: I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
A Journey Beyond#138.dst: Madenciler yüzlerce yıl önce burada demiştin hani?
A Journey Beyond#138.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#139.src: They were. I don't know why it would be so well presevered. It's as if nothing has touched it.
A Journey Beyond#139.dst: Öyleydi. Neden bu kadar iyi korunduğunu bilmiyorum. Sanki hiçbir şey dokunmamış.
A Journey Beyond#139.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#140.src: According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
A Journey Beyond#140.dst: Belgelere göre yolun sonuna kadar gitmemiz gerekiyor.
A Journey Beyond#140.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#142.src: So much for nothing being here.
A Journey Beyond#142.dst: Burada hiçbir şey yok demiştik, ne oldu?
A Journey Beyond#142.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#143.src: Why are they only going for me?
A Journey Beyond#143.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#144.src: Aledar, how far is it to the end?
A Journey Beyond#144.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#145.src: I read the same map as you. It didn't even have scale. There should be a bridge ahead, though.
A Journey Beyond#145.dst: Ben de senin okuduğun haritayı okudum. Ölçeği bile yoktu. Ama ileride bir köprü olmalı.
A Journey Beyond#145.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#146.src: Uhh... A destroyed one. And it wasn't cause I blew it up this time!
A Journey Beyond#146.dst: Iıı... Yıkılmış bir köprü. Ve bu sefer onu ben havaya uçurmadım!
A Journey Beyond#146.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#147.src: Hmm, well we will have to go around.
A Journey Beyond#147.dst: Hmm, o zaman etrafından dolaşmamız gerekecek.
A Journey Beyond#147.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#148.src: This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
A Journey Beyond#148.dst: Bu pek yozlaşmaya benzemiyor, değil mi?
A Journey Beyond#148.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#149.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling really wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149.dst: Iıı... Kendimi pek iyi hissetmi-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#150.src: Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
A Journey Beyond#150.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#153.src: Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
A Journey Beyond#153.dst: Aledar, belki de artık geri dönmeliyiz?
A Journey Beyond#153.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#154.src: Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
A Journey Beyond#154.dst: Elphaba son derece yetenekli bir savaşçıdır. Savaşmaya devam edip onu bulacağız.
A Journey Beyond#154.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#155.src: Do you really think it was just an illusion?
A Journey Beyond#155.dst: Gerçekten sadece bir yanılsama mıydı sence?
A Journey Beyond#155.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#156.src: I'm not sure. I hope so.
A Journey Beyond#156.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#157.src: What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
A Journey Beyond#157.dst: Ya biz de enfekte olduysak? Geri dönmemiz gerekmez mi?
A Journey Beyond#157.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#158.src: We can't, Lucio! We have a mission, as you very well know. We continue.
A Journey Beyond#158.dst: Dönemeyiz, Lucio! Bir görevimiz var, sen de çok iyi biliyorsun. Devam ediyoruz.
A Journey Beyond#158.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#159.src: Besides, we might be carrying some of those things too. We can't risk them infesting Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#159.dst: Hem o şeylerden bazılarını biz de taşıyor olabiliriz. Wynn'i istila etmeleri riskini alamayız.
A Journey Beyond#159.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#160.src: Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
A Journey Beyond#160.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#161.src: It feels like something is watching us...
A Journey Beyond#161.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#162.src: Aledar, what is this place? You didn't tell me there was a city here.
A Journey Beyond#162.dst: Aledar, burası neresi? Burada bir şehir olduğunu söylememiştin.
A Journey Beyond#162.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#163.src: There is. A big one, too; there's more ahead. But it doesn't look like anyone's home. The map doesn't have a name for it either.
A Journey Beyond#163.dst: Var. Hem de büyük bir şehir; ileride daha fazlası var. Ama kimse yokmuş gibi görünüyor. Haritada adı da yok.
A Journey Beyond#163.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#164.src: Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
A Journey Beyond#164.dst: Bir saniye, bu madencilerden biri mi? Yaralı mı? HEEEEY! ORADAKİ!
A Journey Beyond#164.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#167.src: Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
A Journey Beyond#167.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#170.src: We can't live alone like this!
A Journey Beyond#170.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#173.src: You need to come with us!
A Journey Beyond#173.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#174.src: It's the only way to keep you safe!
A Journey Beyond#174.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#175.src: It's the only way to make you happy here!
A Journey Beyond#175.dst: Seni burada mutlu etmenin tek yolu bu!
A Journey Beyond#175.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#176.src: It's the only way to make us feel whole!
A Journey Beyond#176.dst: Kendimizi bütün hissetmemizin tek yolu bu!
A Journey Beyond#176.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#177.src: IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
A Journey Beyond#177.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#178.src: AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
A Journey Beyond#178.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#181.src: CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
A Journey Beyond#181.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#183.src: No! How did she disable my spell?!
A Journey Beyond#183.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#185.src: YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
A Journey Beyond#185.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#186.src: YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
A Journey Beyond#186.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#189.src: Just please, stand still a little longer!
A Journey Beyond#189.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#191.src: You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
A Journey Beyond#191.dst: Seni avlamayacaklar! Söz veriyoruz! Kimse bizi avlamaz!
A Journey Beyond#191.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#193.src: THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
A Journey Beyond#193.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#195.src: NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
A Journey Beyond#195.dst: ARTIK KORKU YOK! ARTIK ENDİŞE YOK!
A Journey Beyond#195.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#197.src: No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go ! Quick!
A Journey Beyond#197.dst: Hayır hayır hayır!! Bu kötü, çok kötü! Gitmemiz lazım ! Çabuk!
A Journey Beyond#197.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#200.src: Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
A Journey Beyond#200.dst: Dur, sen sadece madencilerden birisin. Bu bir yanılsama gibi gelmiyor...
A Journey Beyond#200.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#201.src: Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
A Journey Beyond#201.dst: Bak, buradan çıkman lazım. Burası güvenli değil- Dur, bu ses de ne...?
A Journey Beyond#201.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#204.src: Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#204.dst: Fallen City'de Aledar, Lucio ve Elphaba'yı bul.

A Journey Beyond#205.src: {u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
A Journey Beyond#205.dst: {u}! Tamamen haklıymış. Sen de bizimle gelmelisin...
A Journey Beyond#205.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#206.src: Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#206.dst: Fallen City'de Aledar ve Elphaba'yı bul.

A Journey Beyond#207.src: Find Aledar in the Fallen City.

A Journey Beyond#209.src: I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
A Journey Beyond#209.dst: Sanırım bacağım kırıldı. İyileştirecek bir iksirim var ama yukarıda düşürdüm.
A Journey Beyond#209.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#210.src: I feel a bit better.. But something's still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#210.dst: Biraz daha iyiyim.. Ama hâlâ bir şeyler ters.
A Journey Beyond#210.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#211.src: Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
A Journey Beyond#211.dst: Hadi buradan çıkalım, dişimizi sıkalım. Tek bir çıkış yolu var.
A Journey Beyond#211.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#214.src: Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
A Journey Beyond#214.dst: Iyyy. {u}, işler planladığımız gibi gitmedi. Haritama göre daha yarı yolda bile değiliz.
A Journey Beyond#214.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#215.src: I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
A Journey Beyond#215.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#216.src: The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed, but it's imperative we get to the end of this expanse, together.
A Journey Beyond#216.dst: Görev yerine getirilmeli. Plan değişti ama bu diyarın sonuna birlikte ulaşmamız şart.
A Journey Beyond#216.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#217.src: No more running for us, huh {u}? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#217.dst: Artık kaçmak yok, değil mi {u}? Ah, geldik.
A Journey Beyond#217.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#218.src: There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#218.dst: Bir yolu olmalı.. Beni bu şeyin içinde itmen gerekse bile!
A Journey Beyond#218.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#219.src: No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
A Journey Beyond#219.dst: Hayır, şaka yapmıyorum. Sen arabayı koru, ben yolu göstereyim.
A Journey Beyond#219.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#220.src: Escort Aledar through the {p} to {p} at ({~}, -{~}).
A Journey Beyond#220.dst: Aledar'a {p} boyunca ({~}, -{~}) konumundaki {p} bölgesine kadar eşlik et.

A Journey Beyond#221.src: According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
A Journey Beyond#221.dst: Haritaya göre madenciler biraz ileride bir kasaba kurmuş.
A Journey Beyond#221.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#222.src: Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
A Journey Beyond#222.dst: Ne kaldı kim bilir, ama buradan daha güvenli olmalı.
A Journey Beyond#222.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#223.src: I think the Small Monsters will try to Kill me.
A Journey Beyond#223.dst: Bence Küçük Canavarlar beni Öldürmeye çalışacak.
A Journey Beyond#223.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#224.src: While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
A Journey Beyond#224.dst: Büyük Canavarlar da seni Öldürmeye çalışacak.
A Journey Beyond#224.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#225.src: It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
A Journey Beyond#225.dst: İkimizin de bundan sağ çıkmasını sağlamak sana kalmış.
A Journey Beyond#225.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#226.src: The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
A Journey Beyond#226.dst: Görevin kaderi ikimizin birlikte çalışmasına bağlı.
A Journey Beyond#226.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#227.src: Are those... Eyes on the trees?
A Journey Beyond#227.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#229.src: Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#229.dst: Dikkat, küçük canavarlar bana geliyor! Bu şeyin içinde savaşamam!
A Journey Beyond#229.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#230.dst: Bir tane daha geliyor! Dikkat et!
A Journey Beyond#230.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#231.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#231.dst: Harika iş! Görünüşe göre gelmeyi bıraktılar. Devam edelim.
A Journey Beyond#231.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#233.src: Let's keep going! Before they come back.
A Journey Beyond#233.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#234.src: A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
A Journey Beyond#234.dst: O küçüklerden bir sürüsü bana geliyor!
A Journey Beyond#234.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#235.src: This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
A Journey Beyond#235.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#236.src: We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.
A Journey Beyond#236.dst: Yine durmamız gerekecek! Bu kadar canavarın yanından geçemeyiz.
A Journey Beyond#236.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#237.src: We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
A Journey Beyond#237.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#240.src: Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#240.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#241.src: Finally, we've arrived... It's not exactly the town on the map.
A Journey Beyond#241.dst: Sonunda vardık... Haritadaki kasabaya pek benzemiyor.
A Journey Beyond#241.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#242.src: The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
A Journey Beyond#242.dst: Kayıp madenciler burada... Nasıl? Yüzlerce yaşında olmaları lazım!
A Journey Beyond#242.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#243.src: What is this obelisk? It's.. comforting. I recognise this feeling from my time in Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#243.dst: Bu dikilitaş da ne? İçimi... rahatlatıyor. Bu hissi Gavel'daki zamanlarımdan tanıyorum.
A Journey Beyond#243.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#244.src: Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
A Journey Beyond#244.dst: Belki.. ışık dokunmuştur? Öyleyse.. beni iyileştirebilir.
A Journey Beyond#244.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#245.src: Let's see if it does anything to me...
A Journey Beyond#245.dst: Bakalım bana bir şey yapacak mı...
A Journey Beyond#245.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#246.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#246.dst: İşe yaradı... Sayılır. En azından {~} hissediyorum. Daha epey yolumuz var.
A Journey Beyond#246.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#247.src: Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
A Journey Beyond#247.dst: Devam etmeden önce biraz toparlanalım. Kasabanın öbür tarafında buluşuruz.
A Journey Beyond#247.speaker: Aledar
